$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the care pack composed with a dental-practice content seed and a clear sky-blue brand over the luxe-light register. Everything else — pages, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs). The care family's third remix, deliberately apart from care-therapy's couples warmth and care-psychology's scholarly evidence voice: clinical-but-warm dentistry that quotes prices in writing before treatment and treats nervous patients as its specialty.
title: Dentist
description: A modern dental practice site built to disarm the two reasons people avoid dentists — surprise bills and fear: two dentists and a lead hygienist with real bios, dental-specific services from cleanings to implant restoration, written-price and financing copy that answers the money question first, a comfort menu for nervous patients, an in-network insurance strip, and real online booking — hour-long new-patient exams, 45-minute cleanings, same-day emergency visits, and free cosmetic consults projected from each provider's actual week, capacity-1, double-booking impossible. The booking form is deliberately clinically empty: name, contact, visit type — what's wrong with the tooth never touches the site.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these practice and appointments seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twins) — the composed template's Manage editors and booking widget open on the dental practice, not the base clinic.

providers.name: Dr. Mei Nakamura
providers.bio: Eighteen years of restorative work, the last nine on Waverly Court. Mei opened the practice on one rule: you hear the price and the plan before the chair reclines. She keeps the trickiest crown and veneer cases for herself and photographs her margins because she's proud of them.

providers.name: Dr. Andre Ellison
providers.bio: Andre sees every age and specializes in the patients who announce they hate the dentist. His answer is the same every time: numb slowly, narrate everything, and stop the moment a hand goes up. Most of his once-nervous patients now book cleanings without a reminder call.

providers.name: Sofia Fuentes
providers.bio: Twelve years of hygiene and the gentlest scaler in Dane County. Sofia runs the practice's cleaning schedule and its periodontal program — and she'll tell you honestly whether you need to floss more or just needed a better cleaning technique all along.

services.name: Cleanings & prevention
services.description: Unhurried hygiene visits with honest coaching — the goal is fewer fillings, not more appointments.

services.name: White fillings
services.description: Tooth-colored composite matched to your enamel, placed under proper isolation so it lasts.

services.name: Crowns & bridges
services.description: Digitally scanned — no goopy impressions — with a written price before any tooth is prepared.

services.name: Clear aligners
services.description: Straighter teeth without brackets: a scan, a plan you approve, and check-ins that respect your schedule.

services.name: Whitening
services.description: Professional whitening with custom trays — real results, honest expectations, no drugstore roulette.

services.name: Implant restoration
services.description: Crowns and bridges on implants, coordinated with a local surgeon we'd send our own families to.

services.name: Same-day emergencies
services.description: A broken tooth or a toothache that won't wait — call before noon and we'll see you today.

services.name: Comfort dentistry
services.description: Nitrous, noise-cancelling headphones, hand-signal stops, and a pace you control. Fear is a reason to come here, not to stay away.

reviews.quote: I avoided dentists for nine years. Dr. Ellison talked me through every step, stopped twice when I raised my hand, and I walked out embarrassed only that I'd waited so long. I've kept every cleaning since.
reviews.name: K. R.

reviews.quote: A crown somewhere else was going to be a mystery number on a bill later. Here it was a printed price before Dr. Nakamura touched the tooth — and the crown matches so well I can't find it in the mirror.
reviews.name: J. M.

reviews.quote: Cracked a molar on a Sunday popcorn kernel, called Monday at 7:05, sat down at 10:30. Sofia checked on me by text that evening. That's the whole review.
reviews.name: T. B.

newPatient.title: What will it cost?
newPatient.body: We're in network with the plans above and we quote every treatment in writing before it starts — including the insurance estimate and your share. No insurance? Our membership plan covers two cleanings, exams, and x-rays for a flat yearly fee, and larger treatment can be split into monthly payments. Nobody learns a price from a bill here.

newPatient.title: Your first visit
newPatient.body: New-patient exams run a full hour: digital x-rays, a gum health check, time with the dentist, and a written plan with prices — most visits include your cleaning too. You leave knowing exactly where your mouth stands and what, if anything, comes next.

newPatient.title: Nervous? Say so.
newPatient.body: Tell us when you book — it changes how we schedule you, not how welcome you are. Longer appointment, slower numbing, nitrous if you want it, headphones if you'd rather not hear a thing, and a hand signal that stops everything instantly. Every step is narrated before it happens.

newPatient.title: Emergencies
newPatient.body: A broken tooth, a lost crown, or a toothache that kept you up: call before noon and we'll see you the same day, usually within a couple of hours. We'll get you out of pain first and talk about the long-term fix once you can think straight again.

types.name: New patient exam
types.description: A full first hour: digital x-rays, a gum check, and a written plan with prices — usually your cleaning too.

types.name: Cleaning & check-up
types.description: Your regular hygiene visit with Sofia, plus a check from the dentist — in and out in 45 minutes.

types.name: Same-day emergency
types.description: Pain, a break, or a lost crown — we get you comfortable first and plan the fix second.

types.name: Cosmetic & aligner consult
types.description: A free conversation about whitening, veneers, or clear aligners — options and honest prices, no commitment.

theme.$comment: Clear sky blue over the luxe-light register's near-white ground — the care family's calm, credible light voice re-inked from clinical teal to a fresh morning-sky blue, visibly apart from the therapy remix's warm clay and the psychology remix's scholarly slate. mode light opens the site in its native daylight appearance; marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-inks pages and app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared careShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the base clinic wears the full-width administrative band, the therapy remix the centered masthead, and the psychology remix the split letterhead — so the dental practice takes the contained inline card, the friendliest of the four reads, per the nav-variety audit.
